features.statement: Page declares a document language attribute on the html element.
Uses semantic landmark elements (header, section, footer, lists) instead of generic div-only structure.
Heading hierarchy is clean: a single h1 with section titles as h2 and footer column headings as h4.
Images carry descriptive alt text rather than empty alt attributes.
Uses system font stacks (Trebuchet-style body, Impact display) with no custom web fonts.
Hero headline and card subtitles are set in a heavy condensed all-caps display sans at very large size.
Eyebrow labels and section headings use yellow condensed display type on dark backgrounds.
Body text is 16px with roughly 1.55 line height.
Warm cream page background with dark navy body text.
Dark navy bands recur across consecutive sections, including the footer, paired with yellow accents.
Hero photos appear in near-natural color without flat duotone tint overlays.
Persistent dark header bar with logo and uppercase text navigation links.
Announcement notice is a full-width colored strip with inline heading and a close button.
Buttons and link chips are rounded pills, including filled yellow and outlined white variants.
Link groups are shown as a row of outlined pill chips instead of plain lists.
CTA cards are white rounded cards with text links ending in arrows.
Social icons are round circular letter badges rather than icon-font glyphs.
Footer has light sentence-case links under uppercase headings, with a thin divider above the copyright.
Content is constrained to a centered container of about 1120px.
Feature sections use full-bleed background images with a dark overlay and text overlaid on the left.
Sections are centered, with headings and chip lists aligned to the center of the full width.
Two-column sections place text in one column and a card or image in the other.
Vertical rhythm is tight, giving a shorter page with less whitespace between sections.
Page is lean, with no external scripts or stylesheets, one inline style block, and few divs.
Class names are semantic rather than utility-style.
Cards and photos use solid offset bottom-lip edges and tilted elements with shadows instead of soft layered effects.
No brush-stroke or torn-paint dividers appear at section edges.
Page title uses a tagline with an en dash separator.
Hero halves are labeled with a logo and a short uppercase caption.
Promo headline is a full uppercase sentence in large display type with the offer as a small label above.
Inline text links are underlined and yellow rather than uppercase tracked.
Standalone slogan graphic is a smaller stencil image inside a white shadowed card.
